heading: Measurement provenance
title: Title
help: Values retain their exact spelling. Conversion and calibration are declarations linked to retained sources; Observanda does not execute a decoder or infer physical units.
clockHelp: A frequency or time label does not improve oscillator precision. Wrap/reset and uncertainty are declared separately; no elapsed time is inferred. External time transformations require both a model and reference data.
rawHelp: Raw instrument codes have no physical unit. Retain a separate derived measurement with its conversion and calibration sources when appropriate.
integrityHelp: Integrity and completion below are the author's declarations. Authenticating stored bytes does not establish measurement accuracy or apparatus success.
unresolved: This native identifier is preserved but has no byte or structured-field mapping. Download the original or add a mapped locator; Observanda does not execute imported decoders.
bytesHelp: Hexadecimal and UTF-8 views include up to 64 surrounding bytes. Downloads of a displayed slice contain only its selected bytes. The complete encrypted original is authenticated before inspection.
jsonHelp: This is a bounded JSON value view with exact numeric tokens. Whitespace and escaping may differ; Download original recovers the unchanged bytes.
range: Selected bytes {offset}–{end}; {total} bytes in the locator. Context begins at {context}.
invalid: Choose a source and a valid locator. Keep raw codes unitless; external time transformations need model and reference data.
tooMany: Up to 32 contributing locators can be retained per measurement.
nativeMappingHelp: Optionally link decoded rows to a retained original. Column numbers start at 1. Byte offsets and lengths must be exact decimal integers; no decoder runs inside Observanda.
approximateHelp: Plot coordinates use binary floating point. This option explicitly permits rounding large integers, long decimals and radix fractions. Exact source values and the transformation choice remain retained.
plotPrecision: This value loses precision as a plot coordinate. Keep the exact value in a retained dataset and explicitly allow approximate plotting, or enter the intended rounded coordinate.
plotRounded: Some coordinates were explicitly rounded for plotting. Keep the original file as evidence when its exact values are needed.
plotCollapsed: Distinct exact horizontal coordinates share a rounded plot position. They remain separate observations or groups; inspect the source values to distinguish them.
plotReduction: Groups and summaries are calculated with exact rational values. Only the final coordinates are converted for plotting.
summaryPrecision: The exact summary exceeds the current numeric calculation capacity. No rounded summary has been substituted.
schemaHelp: Column provenance applies to this retained schema revision. Individual exceptions and native locators can be retained from Inspect value.
notPresent: This cell has no observed numeric value.
unitHelp: Dimension identifiers are your explicit declaration. Labels do not imply dimensions. Leave the list empty only for a declared dimensionless quantity.
unitFormula: Canonical value = source value * scale + offset. Scale must be positive; differences have zero offset. This declaration does not establish calibration or accuracy.
unitInvalid: Use distinct dimension identifiers, nonzero integer exponents from -32 to 32, a positive exact scale and a valid offset. Differences require zero offset.
unitLimits: Up to 16 dimension identifiers; integer exponents from -32 to 32, excluding zero. Exact scale and offset spellings follow their declared resource limits. Without declared limits, the earlier 8,192-character limit applies.
clockDeclare: Declare exact counter modulus or rate
clockDefinitionHelp: A declared rate does not resolve resets or wraps, or establish synchronization. Hardware width and frequency remain separate facts.
clockInvalid: Declare a positive whole-number modulus or a positive exact rate. A typed interval must be a difference quantity.
transition-interval: Derived interval using the declared model
transition-help: Each transition uses this pinned dataset row and its immediately preceding acquisition row, before graph filtering. A derived interval is not measured device or wall-clock time. Wraps and resets are never inferred from a decrease.
transition-absence: Wrap controls contain exact nonnegative integers. Reset controls contain 0 or 1; a reset has no known interval across it. Missing or excluded endpoints never become zero. Retain a status output with the same rule to explain every transition.
transition-invalid: Choose valid pinned counter and control columns.
transition-status-invalid-counter: Counter endpoint is not a valid count
transition-status-ambiguous-decrease: Decrease is not explained by the declared wrap count
intervalHelp: Bounds describe a closed set. Name the method explicitly. Statistical coverage is optional and is never inferred or carried through arithmetic.
intervalInvalid: Declare an interval method and a valid exact coverage level between zero and one.
scalarChanged: The selected revision or resource limits changed. Your retained value was kept; select it again to read it.
scalarGraphUpgradeHelp: This saves a new graph version with explicit resource limits on declarations. Earlier graph revisions keep their original interpretation.
scalarPolicyEnable: Declare resource limits for this interpretation
scalarPolicyHelp: These saved limits govern this declaration and its complete scalar text. Pasted values and later calculations cannot enlarge them. Earlier versions keep their original limits.
scalarLoaded: Complete text loaded. Review the edit before saving.
scalarCancelled: Text loading cancelled; the retained value is unchanged.
scalarUnavailable: The selected retained text is unavailable or changed. Reopen this view.
scalarLimit: This value exceeds the declared scalar limit. The retained value is unchanged.
exactApproximateInputs: Exact encoding of value computed from approximate inputs
approximationHelp: An exact encoding preserves the stored digits. It does not make the computation mathematically exact or establish an error bound.
approximateRepresentation: Exact encoding of the stored approximation
sync-help: Pair two source readings with two reference readings that describe the same events. The saved model applies a positive affine relation within its declared source validity. Host time, calendar meaning, wrap counts and resets are never inferred.
sync-targetHelp: The target unit, quantity and time interpretation are copied from the selected reference column.
sync-targetMissing: Choose the reference column to review its target declaration.
sync-validityHelp: Enter exact source bounds within the span of the two source anchors. Both bounds are included. Values outside the interval are never extrapolated.
sync-incomplete: Choose a source column, a reference column and all four paired readings.
sync-eligibleHelp: Anchors require scalar elapsed, inferred elapsed or externally interpreted time. Any existing clock declaration must explicitly have no wraps and no resets. Other columns can be inspected but cannot supply anchors.
sync-invalidAnchor: Choose a present, included scalar time reading with no declared wrap or reset.
sync-graphUpgradeHelp: Save graph version 9 with explicit resource limits. Synchronization nodes pin a retained two-anchor model; older graph revisions and datasets retain their original interpretation.
sync-graphModelMissing: Choose a retained clock synchronization model.
sync-graphModelInvalid: The selected analysis is not a retained two-anchor clock synchronization model.
sync-graphHelp: Value outputs use the target declaration. Status outputs retain ready, missing-input, excluded-input or outside-validity. Absent leaves out-of-validity values unavailable; error refuses that calculation.
sync-working: Clock operation in progress. Please wait.
domain-preserve: This declaration is preserved exactly. Choose a supported codec explicitly to create a different interpretation.
domain-help: Vectors use [a,b], matrices use [[a,b],[c,d]], complex values use [real,imaginary], and closed intervals use [lower,upper]. Declare the interval method separately; bounds do not imply statistical confidence. Quote non-decimal component spellings. Symbols preserve exact original text. Components are paged; no magnitude or ordering is inferred.
domain-tensorHelp: A tensor declaration has 3 to 16 explicit dimensions. Values use nested arrays matching every dimension. No axis meaning, broadcasting or shape is inferred. Historical opaque tensor declarations remain unchanged until you explicitly choose this interpretation.
domain-tensorPolicy: Tensor declarations require saved component resource limits. Those limits remain attached to this interpretation.
domain-shapeInvalid: Enter positive whole dimensions separated by commas, with the rank required by the selected codec and a total component count within exact indexing capacity.
domain-invalid: Declare a valid domain shape, resource policy and exact component interpretation.
domain-tensorOrder: The last coordinate varies fastest. Coordinates identify components within the declared shape; no physical axis meaning is inferred.
unitPublicContext: Declared {kind}; dimensions {dimensions}; scale {scale}; offset {offset}. Canonical value = value * scale + offset.
unitPublicRetained: retained scalar; inspect the source declaration
sync-methodChoiceHelp: Select the declared model you want to author. Existing saved models retain their original method.
sync-publicSegmentedContext: {method}; {count} declared segments{source}. Values use adjacent anchors within each segment’s declared row and clock ranges; no extrapolation or interpolation across resets.{epoch}
sync-piecewise-help: Declare source row ranges for each clock segment and pair observations of the same events. Within each segment, values use linear interpolation between adjacent paired anchors. Every segment has an explicit closed clock validity interval.
sync-piecewise-noInference: No reset, wrap, event match or calendar meaning is inferred. This interpolation does not establish timing accuracy or an uncertainty model.
sync-piecewise-busy: Reading or saving the pinned clock model. Your current entries are retained.
sync-piecewise-historical: This is an earlier model revision. Its sources and anchors remain readable. Open the current model from Evidence & analysis to make an amendment.
sync-piecewise-rangeText: Original source rows: page {firstPage}, row {firstRow} through page {lastPage}, row {lastRow} (inclusive)
sync-piecewise-rangeHelp: Enter inclusive page and row addresses from the original pinned source dataset, starting at 1. Segment selection uses these row addresses, so repeated clock readings after a reset remain distinct.
sync-piecewise-validityHelp: Declare the closed source-clock interval admitted in this segment. It must lie between its first and last anchors before this model can be used.
sync-piecewise-anchorHelp: Pair the same observed event in the source and reference columns. At least two pairs are required per segment. Source rows and both clock coordinates must increase in the authored order; moves are explicit and the complete model is checked before calculation.
sync-piecewise-fixedColumns: Source and reference columns are pinned while this model has segments. Remove all segments before changing those columns.
sync-piecewise-invalidColumn: Choose an elapsed or externally referenced numerical clock column without wrap. Only the source clock may declare observed resets.
sync-piecewise-chooseBoth: Choose valid source and reference columns before saving. Your model draft is retained.
sync-piecewise-retained: Retained value; inspect to read its exact spelling
sync-piecewise-invalidCell: Choose a present, non-excluded numerical clock cell. Your paired-anchor draft is retained.
sync-piecewise-chooseBothCells: Select both pinned cells before saving this paired anchor.
sync-piecewise-graphUpgradeHelp: This explicit graph version supports pinned segmented clock models. Earlier graph revisions and results keep their original versions and models.
sync-piecewise-graphVersionRequired: Enable segmented clock synchronization before using this version 2 model. Your node choices are retained.
sync-piecewise-outputExcluded: Excluded by the calculation's row selection.
computationPerCell: Computation is recorded separately for each value
computationApproximateMethod: Approximate Pearson correlation under the saved calculation policy
declaredDomainComponents: Exact declared components; no magnitude or order is inferred.
preservedDomainCodec: This codec version is preserved without semantic interpretation.
